verdict.rationale: Mastra documents storage-backed suspend/resume for workflows and agents, explicitly stating execution state is remembered so a run can pause indefinitely and resume where it left off, which covers crash/restart-style resumability for workflow steps. However, evidence doesn't explicitly confirm automatic checkpointing on unexpected crashes (vs. deliberate suspend calls) or agent-level (non-workflow) state recovery. Missing for 10: explicit crash-recovery semantics distinct from intentional suspend, independent/hands-on confirmation of resume-after-crash, and detail on what state is persisted (memory, tool calls, step outputs) during an actual failure.
